content.text:
**What I took away:** The page splits things into "where the money sits" (bank account, deposit, קרן השתלמות, securities account) and "what it's invested in" (S&P 500, Tel Aviv indexes, government bonds, cash). So for me the ones worth checking are the קרן השתלמות I already have, a קרן כספית for money I need to keep handy, and maybe the S&P 500 through a חשבון ניירות ערך at my bank. I'm only fairly sure. What made it click was the "מאיפה להתחיל" bit, three lines near the top. Still, nobody told me what to actually do first, how much anything costs, or what it earns.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page.** I saw "מדריך", "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה", so it's what I wanted and I stayed. "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון": I got the idea that where the money sits and what it's invested in are two separate things. That was useful.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל".** Three links: "קרן השתלמות", "קרן חדשה מקיפה", "קרן כספית". That's the closest the page gets to telling me what to do. The pension is through work, so that's sorted.
- **"איפה הכסף מוחזק".** Lots of cards in groups: "כסף שוטף וקצר", "חיסכון עם הטבת מס", "פרישה", "לילדים". I just read the titles. I skipped the kids and retirement ones. "קופת גמל להשקעה" sounds like something for older people, so I skipped it.
- **"לבחירה עצמית".** I stopped on "חשבון ניירות ערך", which says "בבנק, בבית השקעות", so that's where you buy shares and funds.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע".** There are 12 cards. I stopped on "מדד S&P 500", the one my friends talk about. I didn't really get "קרן שעוקבת אחריו". Is that the same as a קרן מחקה or a תעודת סל? It doesn't say.
- **Bottom.** I skipped "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" and the footer.

**Words I didn't get:** מק"מ, אג"ח צמודה / לא צמודה, "קרן נאמנות", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", "MSCI AC World", "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", "קופת גמל בניהול אישי", "קופון", "מסלול כללי".

**What bothered me:**
- There are about 30 cards that all look the same. Past the middle I was just thumbing through, and I'd probably have closed the page around the index cards.
- There isn't a single number anywhere: no fees in shekels, no returns, nothing comparing one option with another.
- It doesn't tell me what to do first with 30,000 ₪.
- The S&P card and the חשבון ניירות ערך card are far apart. It doesn't say how they fit together.
- "מק"מ" appears twice, in two different sections.
